note: Joshua Tree NP campground among the boulders of the park's central Hidden Valley, popular with climbers. The 25-ft limit is for vehicle and trailer combined. Generators are allowed only 7-9 am, noon-2 pm and 5-7 pm. --Claude
summary: Hidden Valley (Joshua Tree NP): nps.gov + NPS API + rec.gov search. Keep. First-come confirmed (no rec.gov listing), $25, 44 sites, 25 ft combined, year-round, pit toilets, no water; filled no hookups/showers/dump, 6-person cap. Phone flag.
